YOI-BOI: A die beside the Favorite star (and beside YOUR SOUNDS on LIBRARY) loads a random sound from the Library view you're on, never the one already loaded.
THROW-UP: A dice key beside the preset arrows loads a random room from the bank the arrows browse, never the one already loaded.
The preset box shows the right name when one user preset replaces another.
BACK-SCRATCH: A shuffle key beside the preset arrows loads a random preset, factory or yours, never the one already loaded. With slot B-H selected it loads into that slot.
SHIFTY: RANDOM now switches the engine (TALK, MOUTH or CLASSIC) and Vowel Color too, so every click sounds different. Right-click the engine selector to lock it.
A die beside PRESETS loads a random preset from the list you're viewing.
ENERGY HARVESTER: A die beside the preset arrows loads a random preset, never the one already loaded.
A preset saved under a name that's already taken now lists under its numbered name.
STUTTER-STEP: A shuffle key beside SAVE loads a random stored groove, factory or USER, never the one already loaded. NEW GROOVE still makes a brand-new one.
